text: {"memo": "In FY2024, McDonald\u2019s generated $25.92\u202fbillion in revenue, up from $25.49\u202fbillion in FY2023, reflecting modest top\u2011line growth. Operating income improved to $11.71\u202fbillion in FY2024 from $11.65\u202fbillion in FY2023, while net income slipped to $8.22\u202fbillion from $8.47\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS was $11.39 in FY2024 versus $11.56 in FY2023. Operating cash flow remained strong at $9.45\u202fbillion in FY2024, slightly below the $9.61\u202fbillion recorded in FY2023. The company maintained healthy profitability, with operating margins hovering around 45% and a net margin near 32%. Despite a slight dip in net earnings, the consistent cash generation and stable operating performance support a buy rating."}
